summary: A Malheur National Forest lookout in Grant County, Oregon, with a 1920s crow's nest origin and a present R-6 cab dated 1960 or 1966; staffed each summer.

access.note: Public parking; visitors welcome during daylight hours. Staffed in summer; the forest asks visitors to respect staff after hours and during high fire activity.

events.note: First lookout was a tree crow's nest. Register says early 1920s; firelookout.com says used as the first lookout in 1922.
20-foot pole tower with L-4 cab (register and firelookout.com). firelookout.com also lists a 30-foot tower with 8x8 cab one mile east.
Present R-6 cab: register and Wikipedia give 1960; firelookout.com gives 1966.
Listed among staffed lookouts on the Blue Mountain Ranger District, staffed throughout the summer.
Staffed by veteran observer David Sheffel as of 2025, per the register.

corrections.why: 2.4 m matches no source. firelookout.com gives the present tower as 53 feet (about 16.2 m), but that may be the overall height rather than the height to the cab floor. Confirm before use.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record's 1960 date is the register's date for the present R-6 cab. The 1920s crow's nest and 1933 pole tower were earlier lookouts on the same summit. firelookout.com's 1966 date for the same cab is not reconciled.

sources.title: Malheur National Forest staffs fire lookouts

notes_for_editor: Present-cab year conflicts: register and Wikipedia say 1960, firelookout.com says 1966. Record height_m 2.4 is wrong; proposed 16.2 m from firelookout.com's 53 ft, which may be overall height. firelookout.com also describes a 30-foot Snowshoe lookout a mile east; the story omits it because the sources give little detail. The 2025 staffing is from the register; the 2023 notice is from a local news report. No drive-up or trail information found. No photos gathered.
